message.content: Li Hua expressed a strong positive reaction to the "Blood and Wine" expansion in the context of "The Rings of Power." According to their conversation, Li Hua found the expansion to be rich with lore and particularly stood out due to the engaging storyline and a surprising twist at the end. This indicates that Li Hua was not only impressed by the narrative depth and development but also enjoyed the visual and thematic elements introduced in this part of the series. The emphasis on character development, as mentioned by Emily Burnett, aligns with Li Hua's appreciation for character backstories and character evolution in the series, further highlighting their interest in both the story and its representation in the visual medium.
